game_title: Call Stack Tower – Sled Run Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Sled Run, a steep sled run: the innkeeper must handle ice wolves while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sled Run: a steep sled run
core_gameplay_loop: In Sled Run, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the ice mill using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the ice mill is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
